verdict.rationale: YYLO Skills is a skills and plugin pack that installs into external agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Pi and Cursor. It supplies instructions those agents use. It is not an application that could host its own built-in assistant, so this story's axis does not apply to this kind of product. Any task delegation, such as the Ralph loop, is carried out by the host agent and would not count as a product capability.
